{{Quote|Dool Pundar! That's is his pirate ship! He can't be here by coincidence...|[[Nuru Kungurama]]|<ref name="TCW:SA" />}}
A '''skirmish''' took place at the [[Fondor Shipyards/Legends|Fondor Shipyards]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], [[Dool Pundar]]'s [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class battleship]] [[Profit (Lucrehulk-class battleship)|''Profit'']] ambushed a small [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] task force above [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]] to steal its cargo of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] brains. While [[Breakout Squad]]'s [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Nu''-class shuttle]] and [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]]'s [[Kit Fisto's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B interceptor]] attacked the [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Nuru Kungurama]] crash-landed his freighter into one of the [[Hangar/Legends|hangars]] of the ''Profit'' to capture Pundar. The pirate captain soon ordered his crew to abandon the ship and fled in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]]. Kungurama and [[Gizman]] fought several [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1 battle droids]] and eventually took control of the ''Lucrehulk'' battleship.<ref name="TCW:SA" />
